prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field shot focuses on a hand-drawn sketch of two interlocking gold wedding rings on a sheet of white paper. The rings are rendered with delicate, precise lines and subtle golden hues, suggesting careful attention to detail and a sense of intimacy. The background is softly blurred, with only the faintest suggestion of a hand or head in the foreground, out of focus, emphasizing the viewer’s attention on the drawing itself. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the texture of the paper. The overall mood is contemplative and tender, evoking a sense of personal reflection or quiet creativity. The composition is intimate and minimalistic, with the rings positioned slightly off-center, creating a sense of narrative and emotional depth.
